== Title ==
<span lang="ja">とどめを刺すぞ</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-248o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">ダーク・ジェダイと能力値＞２の反乱軍キャラクターが同じ戦闘に参加している時に使う。戦闘運命数をもう１枚引いて足す（反乱軍キャラクターがルークなら、２枚引ける）。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「本隊から離脱したやつらを追うぞ。」ダース・ベイダーは、トレンチを進む反乱軍パイロットに、自機のブラスター・キャノンの照準を定めた。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' I'll finish them off.

'''Card text:''' Use when a Dark Jedi and a Rebel character with ability greater than 2 participate in the same battle. Draw and add one more battle destiny. If the Rebel is Luke, you may draw two.

'''Lore:''' “Follow the ones who broke away from the main group.” Darth Vader aimed his fighter's blaster cannon at the Rebel pilot moving down the trench.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 5
* '''Printed subtype:''' Lost Interrupt<ref name="jp-face" />
